actions.List_Active_Rules: List gov_compliancerule where gov_isactive eq true
actions.List_Agents: List gov_agentinventory or single filtered agent

ForEach_Rule.If_Violation: Create or update gov_complianceviolation with status Open

ForEach_Agent.Optional_AutoRemediation: Disable agent if critical + rule gov_autoremediation true

actions.Create_Critical_Alerts: For newly created critical open violations insert gov_alertlog
